purpose: Machine-readable mandatory gate that makes every device/chat discover the shared character-image failure knowledge before image work.
rules: Do not start character image work until the latest main version of CHARACTER_FAILURE_KNOWLEDGE.json has been read.
Apply every ACTIVE failure rule whose appliesTo matches the planned image/edit.
Check recent main commits for work from other devices and do not regenerate newer approved/formal work.
Do not accept another device's PASS/FAIL blindly; reconcile inspected bytes, SHA/path, composite evidence and transaction.
After an image visual FAIL, add reusable image-production lessons to CHARACTER_FAILURE_KNOWLEDGE.json before the next retry.
Do not put runtime, Pages, chart, or general CI failures in the image failure ledger.
failClosed: If the shared failure ledger cannot be read from latest main, do not generate/edit/promote a character image; other non-image work may continue.
discovery: WORK_SYNC.md and CHARACTER_ASSET_PIPELINE.md both point here/at the shared failure ledger so a new chat/device encounters the requirement through normal project entry points.
